# Update Changelog

## New Language Support

1. Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)
2. Japanese
3. Thai
4. Korean

## Changes and Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where users were unable to change skin colors or other attributes on the Avatar page.
2. Fixed an issue with the server filtering feature.
3. Fixed an issue where avatars would not display correctly on the Animation Pack Store page.
4. Fixed various UI issues across certain pages.

## New Features

1. Added support for custom web fonts.
2. Added a customizable home screen header displaying your avatar, username, clock, and total playtime. Each element can be individually enabled or disabled.
3. Added an option to disable the game pinning feature.
4. Added the ability to view item model parameters, texture links, and color settings on the Store's item details page.
5. Expanded server information to include server version, performance metrics, and supported languages.
6. Added the ability to mark friends as favorites.
